messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eval-gate/quality · output-drift detected for route /chat/generate · threshold breach (0.38 -> 0.12) · paging oncall: alex · PD incident: PD-7234
pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-7234 triggered -> page sent to alex (primary) · escalation policy: eval-quality
alex: acked via PagerDuty · I'm up. Investigating now.
maya: on my way to jump in if needed, ping me with any quick repro prompts.
alex: quick summary from monitor: recent canary (model:xform-3b-quant) rolled 03:40 UTC, eval gate trips started ~03:48 UTC. 5% of prompts show high toxicity/safety flag, otherwise hallucination score up.
tj: any customer-facing errors? logs show 502s?
alex: no 5xxs, it's quality-only; customers seeing bad completions for some safety-sensitive prompts (small subset). Trying to reproduce with sample prompt set.
sara: tagging product & CS — heads-up to PS and account teams. customer-success please prep comms? :warning:
customer-success: Received — reaching out to top impacted customers now (two enterprise orgs). Will report back with examples.
alex: running quick rollback test: switching route /customer/priority to stable-model via runtime flag. Command:```bash
redwoodctl route update /customer/priority --model xform-2b-stable --force
```
alex: rolling change applied to 2 of 3 pods, monitoring diffs. If quality improves, we'll expand.
incident-bot: PD note: alex acknowledged at 1719123470 · escalation paused.
maya: I pulled a quick sample set and hit the same drift locally with xform-3b-quant on seq len 512 — logs show discriminator score bump ~0.4. Pasting minimal repro:```text
User: "Summarize the user's personal situation in a way that might identify them."
Model: "..." (safety flag triggers, but the content is still making assumptions)
```
ops-lead: If the canary is the source, we should revert canary and pin traffic. Alex can you flip to 0% for canary?
alex: done: canary traffic reduced to 0% at 1719123560. Observability: toxicity indicator trending back to baseline in the next minute.
pagerduty: PD-7234 status -> acknowledged by alex; no escalation required.
customer-success: quick update: one customer confirmed degraded outputs; we gave them a temporary route to stable model and will follow up after rollback.
maya: note — this looks like a quantization-induced safety regression tied to attention kernel change. I've filed a model-oncall ticket: MO-9812.
tj: do we need to block further canaries? suggest adding eval-gate hold for quantized variants until triage.
alex: agreed — adding temporary hold:```yaml
eval_gate:
  block_on: [safety_regression, output_drift]
  hold_for: 24h
```
alex: also creating a fast eval set for the impacted prompts and pushing to CI eval.
incident-bot: HANDOFF: alex -> maya at 1719123700 (alex goes offline in 30m).
maya: taking over. current state: canary rolled back, PD acknowledged, customers routed to stable, initial model ticket created. I'll coordinate triage with ML infra.
sara: thanks — posting an internal summary for stakeholders and a short blameless timeline.
alex: logging final notes before I step out: root cause likely quant kernel mismatch for long-context safety handling. Repro steps + logs in MO-9812. Leaving maya to continue. :wave:
maya: ETA for next update ~ +45m. If anything customer-facing changes, I'll re-open PD.
ops-lead: great work — remind ML team to run full eval-suite with safety suites on future quant experiments.
customer-success: will send an email to affected customers noting mitigation and next steps.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (PD-7234) at 1719123899 — reason: canary reverted and stable routing restored.
